title: Exact reachability of quadratic lifts of a split radical pencil
body:
This scoped proof classifies all 4,096 quadratic lifts of [[x,y],[y,x]] over F2[x,y]/(x,y)^3 in the two-role right-vector alphabet. A second-order residue class gives exact cost two for 2,048 lifts and excludes the other 2,048 at every word length. It gives both a failure of quotient lifting and reachable targets without an exact common base-field zero. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5a0bcd191f3dd0b9b3950b090f3b0bbf9b9d3950/research/cube-zero-lift-obstruction/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5a0bcd191f3dd0b9b3950b090f3b0bbf9b9d3950/research/cube-zero-lift-obstruction/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5a0bcd191f3dd0b9b3950b090f3b0bbf9b9d3950/research/cube-zero-lift-obstruction/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5a0bcd191f3dd0b9b3950b090f3b0bbf9b9d3950/research/cube-zero-lift-obstruction/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: all 4,096 lifts, 2,048 literal constructions, 1,048,576 covariance checks and all 1,024 nonunit determinant pairs. Both print `PASS_CUBE_ZERO_LIFT_OBSTRUCTION`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cube-zero-lift-obstruction
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted CI is pending at the final check (2026-10-23T17:19:49.153969+00:00): [run 39993842015](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39993842015). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Classify another first-order pencil or the determinant-zero cube-zero stratum before proposing a general reachability theorem. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #4764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4764) and [pinned cube-zero proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/cube-zero-three-factor/README.md) for the higher-nilpotency question and separate cost-three example. His [PR #4276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4276) and [pinned exact two-factor criterion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/right-vector-two-factor-criterion/README.md) supply the finite criterion used for corroboration. His [PR #4776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4776) and [pinned pencil proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/split-radical-pencil/README.md) supply the square-zero split-pencil result and determinant lineage. The [square-zero theorem, PR #4745](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4745), applies only under its original algebra hypothesis. Wentao Li's [PR #4099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4099) supplies the right-vector alphabet, and ToikY's [PR #4334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4334) supplies the common-chart context. Classical determinant and local-ring arguments retain their credit.
